prompt:
How many public schools in Miami-Dade County, Florida are inside FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area?

Your working directory: /root/.cache/hifld-qgis-agent-errors/workspace/claude-haiku-5.5/Q3_2

datasets_used: HIFLD Next: public-schools (NCES CCD 2022-2023 public schools, shapefile zip and geoparquet)
FEMA NFHL Miami-Dade County extract 12086C: S_FLD_HAZ_AR.shp (flood hazard polygons, filtered to SFHA_TF = 'T')
output.method: I filtered the NFHL flood hazard polygons to SFHA_TF='T' (the Special Flood Hazard Area flag) and pre-filtered the HIFLD public schools to a lat/lon box around Miami-Dade. I then ran a point-in-polygon intersect, which returned 181 unique schools (no duplicate NCESIDs). Using the COUNTYFIPS=12086 attribute instead gave the same 181, though some records labeled Miami-Dade are located outside the county (e.g., Viera, Naples) and fall out spatially. All public school statuses were included, with no filter on STATUS.
